caption: The drawing features a rectangular wooden box with a darker brown tone and visible wood grain texture. The box has a base section and an upper section, both bordered with a decorative, ridged black trim. The upper section is fitted with two round black knobs or dials on its front side, and another similar knob is attached to the left side. The top of the box is flat and slightly raised, with a small golden latch or hinge visible on the top edge. The drawing is presented against a blank, off-white background with no other objects. There is a small handwritten label or signature, "Wm Spiecker," in the lower left area near the base of the box.
title: Stereooptician
